patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and WooCommerce share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Sellfy and WooCommerce share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than WooCommerce's shape. Choose WooCommerce only if your buying job matches “Open-source WordPress commerce plugin — free core; paid extensions, hosting, and WooPaymen” rather than Sellfy's shape. Workflow advantage: Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace; WooCommerce leans catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Sellfy and WooCommerce share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; WooCommerce is Open-source WordPress commerce plugin — free core; paid extensions, hosting, and WooPayments processing are separate TCO lines..
- Company-size focus: Sellfy (micro, small-business) vs WooCommerce (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace vs WooCommerce-leaning catalog-management.
- Researched limits: Sellfy — none listed; WooCommerce — You own hosting, security, updates, and plugin compatibility — operational burden vs SaaS.
